en: Black‑and‑white photographic postcard showing a World War I memorial ceremony. Numerous uniformed soldiers and a few civilians stand in formation around a newly erected monument with wreaths at its base and flags raised behind it. The scene is outdoors on grassland. Portuguese text is printed at the top identifying the monument, and more Portuguese text appears on the face of the memorial stone, commemorating Portuguese soldiers who died in the war between 1916 and 1918.
